notes: handover: Approve gate workflowId 6ad1c75967956c53e38f1a70 (saved version 1; the deployed copy is still the contract shell, deployedVersion 1 of definitionVersion 0, until a deploy task). Input keys, all strings, none required: poc_id, role ('manager' or 'owner'), caller_email, caller_name, caller_slack_id. Result keys: status ('decided', 'already_decided', 'forbidden', 'error'), gate_passed (boolean), warnings (list of strings, always present, [] when none), message (string; for a Slack caller it is the line to post, with ' Build session: <link>' appended when Start build started a run). Role manager is matched by caller_email or caller_name against the row's manager_email / manager_name (case-insensitive); role owner by caller_slack_id (a <@U...> wrapper is accepted) against owner_slack_id.

handover: for a row created from Slack the manager_email may be empty (the Slack lookup returned no e-mail for the real user), so the app's Approve button then matches only on caller_name = manager_name; the code-app task should pass both caller_email and caller_name.
